entries.name: Sakuya
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved Sakuya Izayoi chibi character to preserve: same silver hair, blue eyes, serious calm face, navy-white maid outfit and green ribbons. Convert her into a PRODUCTION CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS ATLAS on a genuinely transparent background. Landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows of equally sized 512x512 invisible cells, with generous transparent margins, NO labels, NO grid. SIX ISOLATED pieces, no assembled character. Row1 col1: complete head with face, bangs, maid cap, but no back hair and no neck clothing; row1 col2: isolated armless headless torso from neck to waist in navy vest, green bow, white collar, extend shoulders underneath arm overlap; row1 col3: skirt plus BOTH legs and shoes together, from waist downward only, no torso. Row2 col1: ONLY rear silver hair and braids, no face, no head skin, no cap, suitable behind head; row2 col2: isolated screen-left arm including white puff sleeve, hand holding gold pocket watch, shoulder at top-right and hand toward bottom-left; row2 col3: isolated screen-right casting arm, white puff sleeve and bare forearm with cuff, open hand pointing right, shoulder at left, hand at right. Draw each piece fully with clean rounded hidden joint overlap, consistent 3/4 view facing right, exact same moderate-detail clean anime chibi cel shaded style as reference. All visible skin only face/hands/legs as appropriate. Do not include duplicate arms on torso. No glow, no shadows outside parts, no backdrop, no effects. These pieces will be reassembled with shoulder/neck/waist pivots; precision of separated pieces matters most.

entries.name: Kaguya
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is approved Kaguya Houraisan chibi. Preserve brown eyes, gentle composed expression, black long straight hair, pink kimono sleeves, crimson long skirt, floral accents. Produce a transparent production cutout parts atlas, landscape1536x1024, exactly six isolated pieces in an invisible3columns x2rows grid of512x512 cells, 25px clear margin each cell. NO assembled person, labels, lines, effects or background. Cell1 top-left: entire head with face and front bangs/short side locks ONLY, omit long trailing back hair; neck stump for overlap. Cell2 top-middle: armless headless upper kimono torso, collar and red waist obi, only neck to waist, no skirt. Cell3 top-right: crimson skirt and both feet together, waist to toes, no torso. Cell4 bottom-left: long flowing black rear hair ONLY, no face or skin, smooth upper scalp cap extending behind head. Cell5 bottom-middle: screen-left pink wide kimono sleeve and open hand together, shoulder attachment at top-right, hand extends to left; complete rounded joint. Cell6 bottom-right: screen-right pink kimono sleeve and upturned open hand, attachment at top-left, hand extends right. Keep original moderate-detail chibi cel shading and clean dark linework, consistent3/4 facing right and consistent clothing palette. Hidden joints should overlap cleanly. Fit each part fully in its assigned cell on true alpha transparency.

entries.name: Reimu
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve the approved Reimu Hakurei chibi reference identity, brown eyes, determined face, dark brown hair, huge red hair bow, red-white shrine maiden costume, yellow neck ribbon. Create a true transparent production cutout animation parts atlas, landscape1536x1024 with an invisible3columns x2rows grid of512x512 cells, all six pieces SEPARATED by clear margin. Row1: (1) entire head with face front hair and red headbow, neck overlap, no long trailing rear hair; (2) narrow sleeveless headless torso from neck to waist only, yellow tie/red bodice, no arms no white sleeves no skirt; (3) red skirt with white ruffles plus two legs/shoes together, waist downward, no torso. Row2: (4) trailing rear brown hair ONLY no face, no bow; (5) screen-left arm in wide white detached shrine maiden sleeve, hand pointing left, shoulder at top-right; (6) screen-right casting arm in wide white detached sleeve with red rectangular trim, hand holding entire gohei wooden wand and zigzag paper streamers, shoulder at left and hand at right. Round covered shoulder joints, full length pieces ready to overlap. Consistent3/4 view facing right. Same clean anime chibi moderate cel shaded detail. No assembled character, no labels, no grid, no effects or backdrop. EACH part must fit fully inside its assigned cell with minimum20px transparent gap.

entries.name: Marisa
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is approved Marisa Kirisame chibi. Preserve amber brown eyes, blonde hair, confident lively face, black witch hat with giant white bow, black-white dress. Make a true transparent production cutout animation parts atlas, landscape1536x1024 with exactly 3columns x2rows of512x512 invisible cells, six separated parts. ALL pieces strictly contained in their cell leaving30px margins. Top-left complete head face front bangs and entire witch hat, no long back hair; top-middle sleeveless headless black bodice white collar with tiny green ribbon, neck to waist ONLY no arms no skirt; top-right black-white ruffled skirt plus both legs and black shoes together, waist downward. Bottom-left long blonde rear hair ONLY, no face or hat; bottom-middle rear bent arm with white puff sleeve and hand, shoulder at upper right, hand extended rightward for supporting the furnace, no furnace; bottom-right FRONT casting arm including white puff sleeve and bare forearm with hand firmly holding small octagonal gold-black mini Hakkero furnace at far right (furnace front white central disk), arm pointing right and shoulder at left. This arm should work without the support arm touching. Fully draw hidden rounded shoulder overlaps. Same 3/4 facing-right view, same clean moderate-detail cel shaded anime chibi style. No full character, no text, grid, background, magic effects or cast shadows.

entries.name: Yuyuko
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve approved Yuyuko Saigyouji chibi reference: pink hair, serene closed eyes, tiny gentle smile, blue-white mobcap with red spiral emblem, blue kimono dress with sparse pink cherry blossom patterns and navy bow, white ruffles. Create separated puppet animation parts on true transparent background, landscape1536x1024, 3columns x2rows six-piece atlas with generous clear gaps. Top-left: full head with face front hair and full cap only, neck overlap, no long rear hair. Top-middle: sleeveless headless BLUE TORSO ONLY collar to waist and navy waist bow, NO ARMS, NO SLEEVES, NO SKIRT. Top-right: blue floral skirt and both legs/shoes together from waist down, no torso. Bottom-left: isolated pink rear hair only, no face skin or cap. Bottom-middle: isolated screen-left arm with broad blue floral sleeve and open hand gesturing left, shoulder at top-right. Bottom-right: isolated screen-right arm with broad blue floral sleeve and hand holding entire open pink fan, shoulder at left. All six parts fully drawn with rounded concealed joint overlaps; same3/4 facing right view and clean moderate-detail anime chibi cel shading. No assembled figure, no text, no grid, no effects or shadow outside parts. KEEP all pieces separate with no touching; each part within its own512x512 cell.
